ctx.x: No, Norma and Doc Ryker were coming up from Florida to attend this Bix Beiderbecke festival. And I had invited them to stop at our home because we had kept up our correspondence through approximately 40 some years of Christmas cards. And our communication has stayed intact all these years. And I had invited them to come and visit us en route. And when they arrived, they told us what Doc was working on. And Doc had been interviewing all the Goldkett men. And they came to my home and played these tapes for us. And…
